description: Plan for Storytime Advantage, the English program for Anuban 2 to P2 with a reading and phonics emphasis: four levels of 32 weeks, five scripted daily lessons, a phonics graph under the English domain, a weekly read-along book and song, a decodable per element, printed spaced review, benchmarks, the Chibi Sprouts digital twin, and a Primary catch-up module. Release 1 on 2026-12-01 is Level 2 weeks 1 to 8 in print with songs and books by QR plus the sales pack; Level 2 complete by 2027-02-15 and Level 1 by 2027-04-15. No public date.
deviation_notes: Created 2026-10-21 in the Storytime session after a planning discussion with Daniel. Daniel fixed the program shape (four levels, 32 weeks, 5 periods of 30 and 49 minutes, five scripts, printed spaced review, weekly book and song) and approved the Chibi Sprouts theme. The design document was produced by a Fable design subagent from the research and peer answers of 2026-10-21 (Workbooks, PR, Graph, Monorepo). Planning files only, committed on primary-parity-integration per Monorepo's instruction. 2026-10-22: Daniel answered S1 to S19 on a live approval page; S13 changed from "authoring from March 2027" to a 2026-12-01 release (CEO Phikul, sales priority), so the plan was rewritten with dates and 68 tasks. Closed 2026-10-26 (Daniel, check D4).
